newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: New Australian record drug seizure.
newsitem.headline: New Australian record drug seizure.

text.p: Australian customs on Friday said it had seized six tonnes of cannabis resin, beating a record set last month for the nation's largest drug bust.
"It's the biggest single seizure of drugs," Australian Customs Service spokesman Leon Bedington told Reuters.
Australian Federal Police arrested 14 Australians on Thursday after seizing the drugs onboard a U.S.-registered vessel near Maryborough in Queensland state, Bedington said.
The previous record was 5.1 tonnes of compressed cannabis, valued at A$50 million (US$39.7 million), seized on a ship in Sydney on November 13.
Bedington declined to put a dollar value on the latest seizure. (A$1 = $US0.79)
